About

At Zepto, I work at the intersection of backend and platform engineering. I enjoy identifying problems worth solving, envisioning what the solution could look like and taking it from an idea to a system that operates at scale. My work spans business-critical products, distributed systems and developer infrastructure.

Before Zepto, I studied Mathematics and Computing at IIT Kharagpur and worked on capital markets technology at Barclays.

Outside of work, I spend an inordinate amount of time watching films, following sports, going down obscure rabbit holes and occasionally writing about what I find. I also enjoy quizzing and discovering music.
